cases.translation: Should not the multitude of words be answered?
cases.explain: The preposition без (without) requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Неужели не посрамят тебя, когда ты глумишься, твои ___?
cases.translation: Should your boastings make men hold their peace?
cases.explain: Слова (words) is the subject of the sentence and stands in the nominative plural.

cases.sentence: О, если бы Бог ответил, отверз бы против тебя ___, и сокровенную мудрость тебе открыл
cases.translation: Oh, that God would speak, that He would open His lips against you
cases.explain: The verb отверз (opened) requires the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Если пройдет он, бросит в темницу и созовет ___, кто ему помешает?
cases.translation: If He passes by and shuts up, and calls an assembly, who can hinder Him?
cases.explain: The verb созовет (summons, calls) requires the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Но если ты сердце ему отдашь и руки к нему прострешь, если ___, что в руке у тебя, отбросишь
cases.translation: If you direct your heart right and stretch out your hands to Him, if you put away the sin that is in your hand
cases.explain: The verb отбросишь (cast away) requires the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.translation: And many will make supplication to you
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before, in front of) requires the instrumental case.

reading.ru: Остаться ли множеству слов без ответа? Должен ли Краснобай быть оправданным?
reading.question: What is Zophar asking at the beginning of his speech?
options: Should a man full of talk be left unanswered and justified?
reading.correct: Should a man full of talk be left unanswered and justified?
reading.explain: Zophar questions whether Job's boasting should go unchallenged or unanswered.

reading.ru: Ты говоришь, учение мое верно, и чист я в твоих глазах
reading.question: What does Zophar say Job has claimed?
options: That his doctrine is pure and he is clean in God's sight
That he is the wisest of men
That he is richer than all others
reading.correct: That his doctrine is pure and he is clean in God's sight
reading.explain: Zophar says Job claims his teaching is correct and that he is innocent before God.

reading.ru: О, если бы Бог ответил, отверз бы против тебя уста, и сокровенную мудрость тебе открыл
reading.question: What does Zophar wish God would do?
options: Open His lips against Job and reveal hidden wisdom to him
Give Job all his wealth back
reading.correct: Open His lips against Job and reveal hidden wisdom to him
reading.explain: Zophar expresses a wish that God would respond to Job and reveal the deeper wisdom of God's justice.

reading.ru: Мудрость Божия непостижима. Можешь ли божьи глубины постигнуть?
reading.question: What does Zophar teach about God's wisdom?
options: God's wisdom is incomprehensible; the depths of God cannot be understood
God's wisdom can be easily grasped by humans
Everyone knows all of God's secrets
God's wisdom is inferior to human wisdom
reading.correct: God's wisdom is incomprehensible; the depths of God cannot be understood
reading.explain: Zophar emphasizes that God's wisdom is beyond human comprehension—deeper than any person can fathom.

reading.ru: Но если ты сердце ему отдашь и руки к нему прострешь, если грех, что в руке у тебя отбросишь и прогонишь порог из своих шатров
reading.question: What conditions does Zophar set for Job's restoration?
options: He must give his heart to God, stretch out his hands, cast away his sin, and remove wickedness from his tent
He must leave his home forever
reading.correct: He must give his heart to God, stretch out his hands, cast away his sin, and remove wickedness from his tent
reading.explain: Zophar outlines the steps of repentance: surrender to God, confession, and removal of evil from his life.

reading.ru: Ляжешь, и никто тебя не устрашит, и многие будут заискивать перед тобой
reading.question: What will happen if Job repents and turns to God according to Zophar?
options: He will sleep without fear, and many will seek favor with him
He will become poor and despised
He will be rejected by everyone
He will live in constant terror
reading.correct: He will sleep without fear, and many will seek favor with him
reading.explain: Zophar promises that repentance will bring peace, security, and renewed respect from others.
